description: Search the Données Québec open data catalogue (CKAN) for datasets by keyword, e.g. query "transport": dataset titles, descriptions, publisher and links. Dataset discovery — dataset records themselves are downloaded from the portal; results link back to it. Source: Données Québec. License: Open Government Licence – Canada (OGL-Canada 2.0). French-first catalogue — French keywords return the most results.
